name: RPG Plain Walk Test
description: Headless check that the rpg world runs without turn_battle_base: a minimal map (its own files, no art) is walked with real WASD key events, a wall stops the player, a step trigger runs its commands and sets its self flag, and three plain steps with an Encounters field on the map start no battle. Activated by --itest=rpg_plain_walk with --game=novel_template --new --with-mods=rpg (the template has no battle mechanic; the battles integration does not mount).
